feedback: User can currently create an event for a date that was in the past; creation should be restricted to present/future.
Make sure events can include a description to distinguish them.
View directly calls Model in some places; Controller should mediate.
Display dates/times consistently with input expectations (10/27/2026 versus 2026-10-27; 2:30pm versus 14:30). Instructor reported no UX points deducted.

criteria.description: Every responsibility is in the class that has the data needed to do the job
All dependencies shown, pointing toward what each class depends on; every action can be traced through the classes
All classes are real "things" holding more than one value; single values are attributes
No missing classes, responsibilities or arrows; every user requirement is represented
All entities are present, matching the user requirements, and labeled correctly
All relationships are present and labeled accordingly.

feedback: README: some dense text and not all necessary in README.
UX: no-match actions appear as 'Show all eventsPost an event'.
UX: inputs turn red when filled; red convention communicates an error, so change color.
